text:
kelsey: Heads-up team — pen-test intake: external assessor confirmed Thu 11-14 PT. Need a safe plan for RBAC changes, KMS delegations, and audit capture. Who owns the orchestration? @aj @maria

aj: I can drive RBAC. Thinking ephemeral assessor role via STS with tag-based TTL. Avoid standing group.

maria: Ephemeral sounds good. I'll author the IAM policy and the assume-role constraint (assessor_window tag). Will also lock down permissions to only S3 PutObject + ListBucket for the evidence bucket.

sam: For evidence ingestion, presigned S3 PUT + object metadata for assessor-id works. KMS: don't share decrypt — instead create a KMS grant allowing Encrypt + GenerateDataKey if we need server-side encryption for uploads.

security-bot: Please attach SEC ticket before window. Runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/pen-test-intake

aj: Draft policy snippet:
```
Principal: AWS: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/assessor-ephemeral
Action: sts:AssumeRole
Condition: StringEquals: aws:RequestTag/assessor_window: "1751112222"
```
We will enforce MFA for the assume where possible.

maria: KMS plan: create a temporary CMK alias `alias/pen-test-1751112222` for the bucket, then remove grants after window. Use GrantTokens to track.

kelsey: Audit capture: need CloudTrail events for AssumeRole, S3:PutObject, S3:GetObject, and any EC2/SSM StartSession. Also capture VPC flow logs for data egress checks.

sam: Splunk query draft:
```
index=infra sourcetype=cloudtrail eventName IN (AssumeRole, PutObject, GetObject, StartSession)
| where eventTime >= "2025-07-10T11:00:00Z" AND eventTime <= "2025-07-10T14:00:00Z"
| table eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName, requestParameters.key
```
We'll tag events with assessor_window:1751112222.

aj: Ops checklist: 1) create ephemeral role & policy (maria) 2) presigned PUT generator (aj) 3) create CMK & grants (maria) 4) enable Splunk tagging & dashboard (sam) 5) dry-run w/ simulated assessor (sam) 6) compliance sign-off (kelsey).

maria: I'll start policy + key. Note: set presigned POST to single-use; expire 24h. Add x-amz-meta-assessor-id header enforcement.

sam: Scheduling dry-run: Wed 09:30 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/dryrun-pen

kelsey: Fallback if any change fails: abort window, revoke grants, snapshot bucket (immutable copy), export CloudTrail full logs and open incident bridge. Add `abort->snapshot->revoke` to runbook.

security-bot: Action created: SEC-9112 assigned to kelsey for runbook updates and compliance notes.

aj: I'll add smoke test steps to ticket: generate presigned PUT, upload small file, verify KMS encryption and CloudTrail entry.

maria: Reminder: redact PII from evidence before longer retention. Compliance requires 90-day retention. we'll tag objects with retention metadata.

kelsey: Thanks all. I'll push final runbook by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
